ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Provlaunch.EXE Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of "provlaunch.exe" which might indicate potential abuse to proxy execution.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\provlaunch\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))))
